summary: One coordinated response-handling repair with six behavioral contracts a regen must preserve: (1) live search sends the type parameter Spotify requires and aggregates every populated per-type response path; (2) the agent provenance envelope is added exactly once, by the printer, carrying the caller's real source; (3) single-object endpoints use an empty response path so the whole resource returns, not a nested fragment; (4) --select descends object envelope keys until a bounded nested array collection is found; (5) a multi-type live search keeps already-collected types across a later error, counts only 400s as per-type market rejections, and reports incompleteness in meta.reason; (6) commands that sent a real POST/PUT/DELETE report source=live on every output path.
reason: Live search returned HTTP 400 on every call (missing required type param); fixing it exposed the rest of the chain: double-wrapped envelopes whose outer wrapper claimed source=local for live data, single-object endpoints answering with an artwork array instead of the resource, --select blind past the first object envelope, degraded multi-type search discarding collected results, and mutating commands printing through a provenance-less path. The six contracts stand or fall together: a regen that restores any one of the old extraction paths reintroduces silently wrong output that reads as confident.
validated_outcome: Live: search "radiohead" --data-source live returns one envelope with meta.source=live and aggregated per-type results where the published binary returns HTTP 400; artists get returns the artist; --select reaches nested envelope fields; mutation smoke reports source=live. go build/vet/test, verify-skill pass.
